title: Contents Month Position Under the Coverage — Home Oxygen Therapy Percentages
content:
# Contents Month Position Under the Coverage — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy contents month paid in full by the coverage, the contents amount is multiplied by **90 percent** when the month is the 13th or later contents month paid under the coverage named on the oxygen record, by **95 percent** when it is the 7th to the 12th, and by **100 percent** otherwise. The month's position is the number of contents months already paid under that coverage on the oxygen claim history, plus one. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## Position table

| Contents months already paid under the coverage | Position of this month | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | 1st to 6th | 100 |
| 6 | 7th | 95 |
| 11 | 12th | 95 |
| 12 | 13th | 90 |
| 13 or more | 14th or later | 90 |

## Both sides of each boundary

- 5 already paid: this is the 6th month, 100 percent; 6 already paid: the 7th month, 95 percent.
- 11 already paid: the 12th month, 95 percent; 12 already paid: the 13th month, 90 percent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A contents amount of 79.12 in the 13th contents month under the coverage becomes 79.12 multiplied by 90 percent, 71.208.
